diagnostics.message: is gated on the policy switch "coupon_on_placed_order" and routes to "second", whose capability "conformance.workflow.step" is NOT declared `workflowScoped: true`. A policy switch closes a route, not an execution: it is catalog DATA, so it is one edited line from being open, and behind it must sit a kind no parse can propose in the first place. Declare the capability workflow-scoped, or do not gate it on a policy switch.
